name: Sunny Sunflower
cover:
Did you actually
see the sun
today?

features.label: The usual way
features.headline:
Short days,
indoor hours
features.text:
In winter it's easy to go a whole day
without real daylight and not notice.

features.label: Counts itself
features.headline:
Step outside,
the minutes add up
features.text:
It reads the brightness around you
from camera exposure. No photos taken.

features.label: See your days
features.headline:
A goal from
10 to 120 min
features.text:
Each day keeps its sun time, a mood
and a note. Watch the weeks fill in.

callout.text: Your sunny days at a glance

features.label: Bonus
features.headline:
Your sunflower
grows with you
features.text:
Sun time charges a battery you give
to your sunflower. Skip days, it wilts.

outro:
Stop guessing.
Let the light count itself
points: Apple Watch daylight from Health counts too
Widgets, Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
No server. Your days stay on your device
